```{r}
# 0. Packages
# ------------------------------
required_packages <- c("readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "survival", "writexl")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
      ". Please install them before running this script."
    )
  )
}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(survival)
library(writexl)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

```


```{r}
# 1. File names
# Parentheses and their contents have been removed as requested.
# ------------------------------
file_2011 <- "CHARLS_2011_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2013 <- "CHARLS_2013_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2015 <- "CHARLS_2015_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2018 <- "CHARLS_2018_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2020 <- "CHARLS_2020_cleaned.xlsx"
file_adl  <- "CHARLS_2011_2020_wide_ADL_IADL.xlsx"

output_file <- "A_Never_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx"

input_files <- c(file_2011, file_2013, file_2015, file_2018, file_2020, file_adl)
missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "These input files were not found in the current working directory: ",
      paste(missing_files, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# ------------------------------
first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x2) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  x2[1]
}

first_valid_sex <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[x %in% c(1, 2)]
  if (length(x2) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  as.integer(x2[1])
}

standardize_2011_individual_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11
  x[idx] <- paste0(substr(x[idx], 1, 9), "0", substr(x[idx], 10, 11))
  x
}

standardize_2011_household_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 9
  x[idx] <- paste0(x[idx], "0")
  x
}

marriage_group <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ "Partnered",
    x == 5 ~ "Widowed",
    x %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Separated-Divorced",
    x == 6 ~ "Never married",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

children_group <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "Unknown",
    x == 0 ~ "0",
    x == 1 ~ "1",
    x == 2 ~ "2",
    x >= 3 ~ "3+",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

coresident_group <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 0 ~ "No",
    x == 1 ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

age_group_function <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x >= 45 & x < 55 ~ "45-54",
    x >= 55 & x < 65 ~ "55-64",
    x >= 65 & x < 75 ~ "65-74",
    x >= 75 & x < 85 ~ "75-84",
    x >= 85 & x < 95 ~ "85-94",
    x >= 95 ~ "95+",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ------------------------------
# 3. Read and standardize each cleaned wave
# ------------------------------
read_clean_wave <- function(file, year) {
  d <- read_excel(file, sheet = 1)

  death_col <- paste0("death_", year)
  dibao_col <- paste0("dibao_", year)

  required_cols <- c(
    "individual_id", "household_id", "community_id", "sex", "age",
    "marriage_status_raw", death_col, dibao_col,
    "num_children", "coresident_child", "household_income_per_capita"
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(d))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing required columns in ", file, ": ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  if (!"birth_year_used" %in% names(d)) d$birth_year_used <- NA_real_
  if (!"death_year" %in% names(d)) d$death_year <- NA_real_
  if (!"death_month" %in% names(d)) d$death_month <- NA_real_
  if (!"record_source" %in% names(d)) d$record_source <- NA_character_

  d$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(d$individual_id))
  d$household_id  <- trimws(as.character(d$household_id))
  d$community_id  <- trimws(as.character(d$community_id))

  if (year == 2011) {
    d$individual_id <- standardize_2011_individual_id(d$individual_id)
    d$household_id  <- standardize_2011_household_id(d$household_id)
  }

  if (any(is.na(d$individual_id) | d$individual_id == "")) {
    stop(paste0("Missing individual_id detected in ", file))
  }

  if (any(duplicated(d$individual_id))) {
    stop(paste0("Duplicate individual_id detected within wave ", year, "."))
  }

  bad_iid <- !is.na(d$individual_id) & nchar(d$individual_id) != 12
  bad_hid <- !is.na(d$household_id) & nchar(d$household_id) != 10

  if (any(bad_iid)) {
    stop(paste0("Unexpected individual_id length after standardization in wave ", year, "."))
  }

  if (any(bad_hid)) {
    stop(paste0("Unexpected household_id length after standardization in wave ", year, "."))
  }

  out <- data.frame(
    individual_id = d$individual_id,
    household_id = d$household_id,
    community_id = d$community_id,
    wave = as.integer(year),
    sex = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$sex)),
    age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$age)),
    birth_year_used = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$birth_year_used)),
    marriage_status_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$marriage_status_raw)),
    death = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[death_col]])),
    dibao = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[dibao_col]])),
    num_children = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$num_children)),
    coresident_child_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$coresident_child)),
    household_income_per_capita = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$household_income_per_capita)),
    death_year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$death_year)),
    death_month = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$death_month)),
    record_source = as.character(d$record_source),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out
}

cat("\nReading five cleaned waves...\n")
d2011 <- read_clean_wave(file_2011, 2011)
d2013 <- read_clean_wave(file_2013, 2013)
d2015 <- read_clean_wave(file_2015, 2015)
d2018 <- read_clean_wave(file_2018, 2018)
d2020 <- read_clean_wave(file_2020, 2020)

all_long <- bind_rows(d2011, d2013, d2015, d2018, d2020) %>%
  arrange(individual_id, wave)

cat("Unique persons in five cleaned files:", n_distinct(all_long$individual_id), "\n")
cat("Unique households in five cleaned files:", n_distinct(all_long$household_id), "\n")

# ------------------------------
# 4. Fixed sex from earliest valid observation
# ------------------------------
sex_history <- all_long %>%
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sex_fixed = first_valid_sex(sex),
    n_valid_sex_values = n_distinct(sex[sex %in% c(1, 2)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

n_sex_conflict <- sum(sex_history$n_valid_sex_values > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
if (n_sex_conflict > 0) {
  warning(paste0(n_sex_conflict, " persons have conflicting valid sex values across waves; earliest valid sex is used."))
}

# ------------------------------
# 5. Household Dibao history
# Ever: any explicit Dibao == 1.
# Unknown: no Yes, but at least one ALIVE respondent record has missing Dibao.
# Never: no Yes, no alive missing, and at least one explicit No.
# Death-only rows with missing Dibao do NOT turn a Never household into Unknown.
# ------------------------------
household_dibao <- all_long %>%
  group_by(household_id) %>%
  summarise(
    any_yes = any(dibao == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_alive_missing = any(death == 0 & is.na(dibao), na.rm = TRUE),
    any_no = any(dibao == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_yes_wave = if (any(dibao == 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(wave[dibao == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dibao_group = case_when(
      any_yes ~ "Ever",
      !any_yes & any_alive_missing ~ "Unknown",
      !any_yes & !any_alive_missing & any_no ~ "Never",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

cat("\nHousehold Dibao classification:\n")
print(table(household_dibao$dibao_group, useNA = "ifany"))
```


```{r}
# 6. Method A long-term household per-capita income
# One household-wave value first, then mean across available waves.
# Missing waves are NOT treated as zero.
# ------------------------------
income_hh_wave <- all_long %>%
  group_by(household_id, wave) %>%
  summarise(
    n_distinct_income = n_distinct(household_income_per_capita[!is.na(household_income_per_capita)]),
    income_wave = first_nonmissing(household_income_per_capita),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(income_hh_wave$n_distinct_income > 1)) {
  bad <- income_hh_wave %>% filter(n_distinct_income > 1)
  print(head(bad, 20))
  stop("At least one household-wave has conflicting non-missing household_income_per_capita values.")
}

household_income_A <- income_hh_wave %>%
  group_by(household_id) %>%
  summarise(
    household_income_A = if (all(is.na(income_wave))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(income_wave, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    n_income_waves = sum(!is.na(income_wave)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------
# 7. Reconstruct death time exactly as in revised Method A
# Priority:
#   (1) 2013 reported death year/month where available
#   (2) cleaned birth_year_used + cleaned death age
# Invalid raw time -> midpoint between last alive wave and first death-report wave
# If no prior alive wave -> first death-report wave
# ------------------------------
make_death_info <- function(d) {
  d <- d[order(d$wave), ]
  individual_id <- d$individual_id[1]

  alive_waves <- d$wave[!is.na(d$death) & d$death == 0]
  dead_rows <- d[!is.na(d$death) & d$death == 1, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(dead_rows) == 0) {
    last_alive_wave <- if (length(alive_waves) > 0) max(alive_waves) else NA_real_

    return(data.frame(
      individual_id = individual_id,
      death_confirmed = 0L,
      death_report_wave = NA_real_,
      death_time_raw = NA_real_,
      death_time = NA_real_,
      death_source_raw = NA_character_,
      death_time_source = NA_character_,
      death_time_issue = NA_character_,
      last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  dead_rows <- dead_rows[order(dead_rows$wave), , drop = FALSE]
  dr <- dead_rows[1, , drop = FALSE]
  report_wave <- as.numeric(dr$wave[1])

  prior_alive <- alive_waves[alive_waves < report_wave]
  last_alive_wave <- if (length(prior_alive) > 0) max(prior_alive) else NA_real_

  death_time_raw <- NA_real_
  death_source_raw <- "missing"

  if (report_wave == 2013 && !is.na(dr$death_year[1])) {
    if (!is.na(dr$death_month[1]) && dr$death_month[1] >= 1 && dr$death_month[1] <= 12) {
      death_time_raw <- dr$death_year[1] + (dr$death_month[1] - 0.5) / 12
      death_source_raw <- "reported_year_month"
    } else {
      death_time_raw <- dr$death_year[1]
      death_source_raw <- "reported_year"
    }
  } else if (!is.na(dr$birth_year_used[1]) && !is.na(dr$age[1])) {
    death_time_raw <- dr$birth_year_used[1] + dr$age[1]
    death_source_raw <- "cleaned_death_age"
  }

  death_time_issue <- NA_character_
  raw_valid <- TRUE

  if (is.na(death_time_raw)) {
    raw_valid <- FALSE
    death_time_issue <- "death_time_missing"
  } else if (!is.na(last_alive_wave) && death_time_raw <= last_alive_wave) {
    raw_valid <- FALSE
    death_time_issue <- "death_time_not_after_last_alive"
  } else if (death_time_raw > report_wave) {
    raw_valid <- FALSE
    death_time_issue <- "death_time_after_report_wave"
  }

  if (raw_valid) {
    death_time <- death_time_raw
    death_time_source <- death_source_raw
  } else if (!is.na(last_alive_wave)) {
    death_time <- (last_alive_wave + report_wave) / 2
    death_time_source <- "fallback_midpoint"
  } else {
    death_time <- report_wave
    death_time_source <- "fallback_first_dead_wave"
  }

  data.frame(
    individual_id = individual_id,
    death_confirmed = 1L,
    death_report_wave = report_wave,
    death_time_raw = death_time_raw,
    death_time = death_time,
    death_source_raw = death_source_raw,
    death_time_source = death_time_source,
    death_time_issue = death_time_issue,
    last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

cat("\nReconstructing death times...\n")
death_info <- bind_rows(
  lapply(split(all_long, all_long$individual_id), make_death_info)
)

# ------------------------------
# 8. Create candidate start-wave records
# Start waves: 2011, 2013, 2015, 2018
# Only alive respondent records at interval start.
# ------------------------------
start_waves <- c(2011L, 2013L, 2015L, 2018L)

candidate0 <- all_long %>%
  filter(wave %in% start_waves, death == 0) %>%
  left_join(sex_history %>% select(individual_id, sex_fixed), by = "individual_id") %>%
  left_join(
    household_dibao %>% select(household_id, dibao_group, first_yes_wave),
    by = "household_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(household_income_A, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(death_info, by = "individual_id")

candidate1 <- candidate0 %>%
  filter(dibao_group %in% c("Ever", "Never"))

candidate2 <- candidate1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), age >= 45)

candidate3 <- candidate2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex_fixed), sex_fixed %in% c(1, 2))

candidate4 <- candidate3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(household_income_A))

candidate5 <- candidate4 %>%
  filter(
    dibao_group == "Never" |
      (dibao_group == "Ever" & !is.na(first_yes_wave) & wave >= first_yes_wave)
  )

cat("\nMethod A sample construction before interval stopping:\n")
cat("Alive start-wave records:", nrow(candidate0), "\n")
cat("Eligible Ever/Never records:", nrow(candidate1), "\n")
cat("Age >=45 records:", nrow(candidate2), "\n")
cat("Fixed sex available:", nrow(candidate3), "\n")
cat("Long-term income available:", nrow(candidate4), "\n")
cat("At/after Ever entry when applicable:", nrow(candidate5), "\n")

# ------------------------------
# 9. Build start-stop intervals
# Non-dead persons are censored at last observed alive wave.
# Dead persons end at reconstructed death_time.
# A future alive observation can confirm survival through an intermediate end wave.
# ------------------------------
analysis_intervals <- candidate5 %>%
  mutate(
    start = as.numeric(wave),
    next_wave = case_when(
      wave == 2011 ~ 2013,
      wave == 2013 ~ 2015,
      wave == 2015 ~ 2018,
      wave == 2018 ~ 2020,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    observation_end = ifelse(death_confirmed == 1, death_time, last_alive_wave),
    stop = pmin(next_wave, observation_end),
    event = ifelse(
      death_confirmed == 1 & !is.na(death_time) &
        death_time > start & death_time <= stop,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stop), stop > start)

cat("\nFinal positive-length common Method A intervals:", nrow(analysis_intervals), "\n")
cat("Unique persons:", n_distinct(analysis_intervals$individual_id), "\n")
cat("Death events:", sum(analysis_intervals$event), "\n")

# ------------------------------
# 10. Common Method A income tertile cutoffs
# Cutoffs are calculated from unique eligible households in final Ever+Never intervals.
# ------------------------------
eligible_households <- analysis_intervals %>%
  distinct(household_id, household_income_A)

income_cutoffs <- quantile(
  eligible_households$household_income_A,
  probs = c(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
  na.rm = TRUE,
  type = 7,
  names = FALSE
)

q1 <- as.numeric(income_cutoffs[1])
q2 <- as.numeric(income_cutoffs[2])

cat("\nMethod A common income cutoffs:\n")
cat("T1/T2 cutoff =", q1, "\n")
cat("T2/T3 cutoff =", q2, "\n")

analysis_intervals <- analysis_intervals %>%
  mutate(
    income_tertile = cut(
      household_income_A,
      breaks = c(-Inf, q1, q2, Inf),
      labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = TRUE
    ),
    sex = factor(
      ifelse(sex_fixed == 1, "Male", "Female"),
      levels = c("Male", "Female")
    ),
    marriage_status = marriage_group(marriage_status_raw),
    living_children = children_group(num_children),
    coresident_child = coresident_group(coresident_child_raw),
    age_group = age_group_function(age)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    income_tertile = factor(income_tertile, levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")),
    marriage_status = factor(
      marriage_status,
      levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married", "Unknown")
    ),
    living_children = factor(
      living_children,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
    ),
    coresident_child = factor(
      coresident_child,
      levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
    ),
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
    )
  )

if (any(is.na(analysis_intervals$age_group))) {
  stop("Missing age_group detected after age >=45 filtering.")
}
```


```{r}
# 11. Read ADL/IADL wide file and convert to person-wave long data
# ADL range: 0-6
# IADL range: 0-5
# Higher score = greater functional difficulty.
# ------------------------------
cat("\nReading ADL/IADL wide file...\n")
adl_wide <- read_excel(file_adl, sheet = 1)
adl_wide$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(adl_wide$individual_id))

adl_cols  <- paste0("adl_", c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020))
iadl_cols <- paste0("iadl_", c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020))
required_adl_cols <- c("individual_id", adl_cols, iadl_cols)

missing_adl_cols <- setdiff(required_adl_cols, names(adl_wide))
if (length(missing_adl_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required ADL/IADL columns: ",
      paste(missing_adl_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

if (any(is.na(adl_wide$individual_id) | adl_wide$individual_id == "")) {
  stop("Missing individual_id detected in ADL/IADL wide file.")
}

if (any(duplicated(adl_wide$individual_id))) {
  stop("Duplicate individual_id detected in ADL/IADL wide file.")
}

for (v in c(adl_cols, iadl_cols)) {
  adl_wide[[v]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(adl_wide[[v]]))
}

bad_adl <- unlist(adl_wide[adl_cols], use.names = FALSE)
bad_adl <- bad_adl[!is.na(bad_adl)]
if (length(bad_adl) > 0 && any(bad_adl < 0 | bad_adl > 6)) {
  stop("ADL values outside the expected 0-6 range were detected.")
}

bad_iadl <- unlist(adl_wide[iadl_cols], use.names = FALSE)
bad_iadl <- bad_iadl[!is.na(bad_iadl)]
if (length(bad_iadl) > 0 && any(bad_iadl < 0 | bad_iadl > 5)) {
  stop("IADL values outside the expected 0-5 range were detected.")
}

cleaned_ids <- unique(all_long$individual_id)
unmatched_ids <- setdiff(cleaned_ids, adl_wide$individual_id)
if (length(unmatched_ids) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "ADL/IADL wide file is missing ", length(unmatched_ids),
      " individual IDs that are present in the cleaned waves."
    )
  )
}

adl_long <- adl_wide %>%
  select(all_of(required_adl_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -individual_id,
    names_to = c(".value", "wave"),
    names_pattern = "^(adl|iadl)_(\\d{4})$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(wave = as.integer(wave)) %>%
  arrange(individual_id, wave)

if (any(duplicated(adl_long[c("individual_id", "wave")]))) {
  stop("Duplicate individual_id-wave rows detected after reshaping ADL/IADL data.")
}

analysis_intervals <- analysis_intervals %>%
  left_join(adl_long, by = c("individual_id", "wave"))

# ------------------------------
# 12. Never-Dibao formal sample
# Marriage Unknown is excluded from formal Cox models.
# Children and coresidence Unknown remain as explicit categories.
# ------------------------------
never_original <- analysis_intervals %>%
  filter(dibao_group == "Never") %>%
  filter(marriage_status != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    marriage_status = factor(
      as.character(marriage_status),
      levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married")
    )
  )

# Common M1-M4 sample: both ADL and IADL must be observed at interval start.
never_common <- never_original %>%
  filter(!is.na(adl), !is.na(iadl))

cat("\nNever-Dibao sample sizes:\n")
cat(
  "Original M1: ", n_distinct(never_original$individual_id), " persons; ",
  nrow(never_original), " intervals; ", sum(never_original$event), " deaths; ",
  sum(never_original$stop - never_original$start), " person-years.\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "Common ADL/IADL sample: ", n_distinct(never_common$individual_id), " persons; ",
  nrow(never_common), " intervals; ", sum(never_common$event), " deaths; ",
  sum(never_common$stop - never_common$start), " person-years.\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "Excluded from the common sample because ADL and/or IADL is missing at interval start: ",
  nrow(never_original) - nrow(never_common), " intervals; ",
  n_distinct(never_original$individual_id) - n_distinct(never_common$individual_id), " persons; ",
  sum(never_original$event) - sum(never_common$event), " deaths.\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (nrow(never_common) == 0 || sum(never_common$event) == 0) {
  stop("The common ADL/IADL Never-Dibao sample has no usable intervals or no death events.")
}

# ------------------------------
# 13. Cox models
# Original_M1 = original Method A Never model on full formal Never sample.
# Common_M1   = same model on the common ADL/IADL sample.
# M2_ADL      = Common_M1 + ADL.
# M3_IADL     = Common_M1 + IADL.
# M4_ADL_IADL = Common_M1 + ADL + IADL.
# All common-sample models therefore use exactly the same person-period records.
# ------------------------------
fit_cox <- function(data, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = FALSE) {
  rhs <- c(
    "sex",
    "income_tertile",
    "marriage_status",
    "living_children",
    "coresident_child"
  )

  if (add_adl) rhs <- c(rhs, "adl")
  if (add_iadl) rhs <- c(rhs, "iadl")
  rhs <- c(rhs, "strata(age_group)")

  form <- as.formula(
    paste("Surv(start, stop, event) ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "))
  )

  coxph(
    formula = form,
    data = data,
    ties = "efron",
    cluster = individual_id,
    robust = TRUE,
    x = TRUE,
    model = TRUE
  )
}

cat("\nFitting Cox models...\n")
fit_original_m1 <- fit_cox(never_original, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = FALSE)
fit_common_m1   <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = FALSE)
fit_m2_adl      <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = TRUE,  add_iadl = FALSE)
fit_m3_iadl     <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = TRUE)
fit_m4_both     <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = TRUE,  add_iadl = TRUE)

fits <- list(
  Original_M1 = fit_original_m1,
  Common_M1 = fit_common_m1,
  M2_ADL = fit_m2_adl,
  M3_IADL = fit_m3_iadl,
  M4_ADL_IADL = fit_m4_both
)

model_data <- list(
  Original_M1 = never_original,
  Common_M1 = never_common,
  M2_ADL = never_common,
  M3_IADL = never_common,
  M4_ADL_IADL = never_common
)

# ------------------------------
# 14. Extract complete Cox results: beta, robust SE, HR, 95% CI, p
# ------------------------------
comparison_label <- function(term) {
  labels <- c(
    "sexFemale" = "Female vs Male",
    "income_tertileT2" = "Income T2 vs T1",
    "income_tertileT3" = "Income T3 vs T1",
    "marriage_statusWidowed" = "Widowed vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced" = "Separated-Divorced vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusNever married" = "Never married vs Partnered",
    "living_children1" = "Living children: 1 vs 0",
    "living_children2" = "Living children: 2 vs 0",
    "living_children3+" = "Living children: 3+ vs 0",
    "living_childrenUnknown" = "Living children: Unknown vs 0",
    "coresident_childYes" = "Coresident child: Yes vs No",
    "coresident_childUnknown" = "Coresident child: Unknown vs No",
    "adl" = "ADL: per 1-point increase",
    "iadl" = "IADL: per 1-point increase"
  )

  ifelse(term %in% names(labels), unname(labels[term]), term)
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit, model_name) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  cm <- s$coefficients

  if (is.null(dim(cm))) {
    cm <- matrix(cm, nrow = 1)
  }

  beta <- as.numeric(cm[, "coef"])

  if ("robust se" %in% colnames(cm)) {
    robust_se <- as.numeric(cm[, "robust se"])
  } else {
    robust_se <- as.numeric(cm[, "se(coef)"])
  }

  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(cm), value = TRUE)
  if (length(p_col) == 0) stop(paste0("Could not find p-value column for model ", model_name))
  p_value <- as.numeric(cm[, p_col[1]])

  term <- rownames(cm)
  z975 <- qnorm(0.975)

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    term = term,
    Comparison = comparison_label(term),
    beta = beta,
    robust_SE = robust_se,
    HR = exp(beta),
    lower_95 = exp(beta - z975 * robust_se),
    upper_95 = exp(beta + z975 * robust_se),
    p_value = p_value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

full_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(fits), function(nm) extract_cox_results(fits[[nm]], nm))
)

# ------------------------------
# 15. Compact model comparison table
# ------------------------------
get_effect <- function(result_table, model_name, term_name) {
  x <- result_table %>%
    filter(Model == model_name, term == term_name)

  if (nrow(x) == 0) {
    return(c(HR = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  c(
    HR = x$HR[1],
    lower = x$lower_95[1],
    upper = x$upper_95[1],
    p = x$p_value[1]
  )
}

format_ci <- function(hr, lower, upper) {
  if (any(is.na(c(hr, lower, upper)))) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", hr, lower, upper)
}

build_model_comparison_row <- function(model_name) {
  d <- model_data[[model_name]]

  core <- get_effect(full_results, model_name, "coresident_childYes")
  adl  <- get_effect(full_results, model_name, "adl")
  iadl <- get_effect(full_results, model_name, "iadl")

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Sample = ifelse(
      model_name == "Original_M1",
      "Original Method A Never sample",
      "Common ADL+IADL complete-case person-period sample"
    ),
    Persons = n_distinct(d$individual_id),
    Intervals = nrow(d),
    Deaths = sum(d$event),
    Person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start),
    Coresident_HR_95CI = format_ci(core["HR"], core["lower"], core["upper"]),
    Coresident_p = core["p"],
    ADL_HR_95CI = format_ci(adl["HR"], adl["lower"], adl["upper"]),
    ADL_p = adl["p"],
    IADL_HR_95CI = format_ci(iadl["HR"], iadl["lower"], iadl["upper"]),
    IADL_p = iadl["p"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

model_comparison <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(fits), build_model_comparison_row)
)
```


```{r}
# 16. PH diagnostics
# No automatic alternative model is created.
# We only report potential PH problems.
# ------------------------------
extract_ph <- function(fit, model_name) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      z <- cox.zph(fit, terms = TRUE, global = TRUE)
      tb <- as.data.frame(z$table)
      tb$term <- rownames(tb)
      rownames(tb) <- NULL

      data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        term = tb$term,
        chisq = as.numeric(tb$chisq),
        df = as.numeric(tb$df),
        p_value = as.numeric(tb$p),
        PH_flag = ifelse(
          as.numeric(tb$p) < 0.05,
          "Potential PH violation (p<0.05)",
          "No evidence of PH violation at 0.05"
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning(paste0("cox.zph failed for ", model_name, ": ", conditionMessage(e)))

      data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
        chisq = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        PH_flag = conditionMessage(e),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
}

ph_diagnostics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(fits), function(nm) extract_ph(fits[[nm]], nm))
)

# ------------------------------
# 17. Reproduction QA against the previously confirmed revised A-Never result
# These values are used ONLY as QA references; they do not affect model fitting.
# ------------------------------
qa_messages <- character(0)

if (n_distinct(never_original$individual_id) != 17385) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Original M1 person count differs from expected 17385.")
}
if (n_distinct(never_original$household_id) != 9638) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Original M1 household count differs from expected 9638.")
}
if (nrow(never_original) != 52058) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Original M1 interval count differs from expected 52058.")
}
if (sum(never_original$event) != 1414) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Original M1 death count differs from expected 1414.")
}
if (abs(sum(never_original$stop - never_original$start) - 116669.291666667) > 1e-6) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Original M1 person-years differ from expected 116669.291666667.")
}
if (abs(q1 - 3924.44444444444) > 1e-6) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Method A lower tertile cutoff differs from the previous revised result.")
}
if (abs(q2 - 11548.3548148148) > 1e-6) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Method A upper tertile cutoff differs from the previous revised result.")
}

reference_hr <- c(
  sexFemale = 0.591304328776448,
  income_tertileT3 = 0.720310981617939,
  marriage_statusWidowed = 1.63106390758937,
  coresident_childYes = 1.16159017426927
)

for (tm in names(reference_hr)) {
  current <- full_results %>%
    filter(Model == "Original_M1", term == tm)

  if (nrow(current) != 1 || abs(current$HR[1] - reference_hr[tm]) > 0.01) {
    qa_messages <- c(
      qa_messages,
      paste0("Original M1 HR for ", tm, " differs materially from the previous revised result.")
    )
  }
}

cat("\nOriginal Method A reproduction check:\n")
if (length(qa_messages) == 0) {
  cat("PASS: sample size, households, person-years, income cutoffs, and selected core HRs reproduce the previous revised A-Never result.\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: one or more reproduction checks did not match:\n")
  for (m in qa_messages) cat(" - ", m, "\n", sep = "")
}

# ------------------------------
# 18. Console output: only the main results
# ------------------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("MAIN MODEL COMPARISON\n")
cat("HR > 1 means higher mortality hazard; HR < 1 means lower hazard.\n")
cat("ADL/IADL HRs are per 1-point increase in score.\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
print(model_comparison, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nGLOBAL PH TESTS\n")
print(
  ph_diagnostics %>%
    filter(term == "GLOBAL") %>%
    select(Model, chisq, df, p_value, PH_flag),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------
# 19. Write ONE Excel workbook with THREE sheets only
# ------------------------------
write_xlsx(
  list(
    Model_Comparison = model_comparison,
    Full_Cox_Results = full_results,
    PH_Diagnostics = ph_diagnostics
  ),
  path = output_file
)

cat("\nFinished.\n")
cat("Output file:", output_file, "\n")
cat("Sheets: Model_Comparison, Full_Cox_Results, PH_Diagnostics\n")
```
