```{r}
# 0. Packages
# ------------------------------
required_packages <- c("readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "survival", "writexl")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
      ". Please install them before running this script."
    )
  )
}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(survival)
library(writexl)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 1. File names
# Parentheses and their contents have been removed as requested.
# ------------------------------
file_2011 <- "CHARLS_2011_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2013 <- "CHARLS_2013_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2015 <- "CHARLS_2015_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2018 <- "CHARLS_2018_cleaned.xlsx"
file_2020 <- "CHARLS_2020_cleaned.xlsx"
file_adl  <- "CHARLS_2011_2020_wide_ADL_IADL.xlsx"

output_file <- "A_Never_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx"

input_files <- c(file_2011, file_2013, file_2015, file_2018, file_2020, file_adl)
missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "These input files were not found in the current working directory: ",
      paste(missing_files, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# ------------------------------
first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x2) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  x2[1]
}

first_valid_sex <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[x %in% c(1, 2)]
  if (length(x2) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  as.integer(x2[1])
}

standardize_2011_individual_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11
  x[idx] <- paste0(substr(x[idx], 1, 9), "0", substr(x[idx], 10, 11))
  x
}

standardize_2011_household_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 9
  x[idx] <- paste0(x[idx], "0")
  x
}

marriage_group <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ "Partnered",
    x == 5 ~ "Widowed",
    x %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Separated-Divorced",
    x == 6 ~ "Never married",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

children_group <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "Unknown",
    x == 0 ~ "0",
    x == 1 ~ "1",
    x == 2 ~ "2",
    x >= 3 ~ "3+",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

coresident_group <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 0 ~ "No",
    x == 1 ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

age_group_function <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x >= 45 & x < 55 ~ "45-54",
    x >= 55 & x < 65 ~ "55-64",
    x >= 65 & x < 75 ~ "65-74",
    x >= 75 & x < 85 ~ "75-84",
    x >= 85 & x < 95 ~ "85-94",
    x >= 95 ~ "95+",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ------------------------------
# 3. Read and standardize each cleaned wave
# ------------------------------
read_clean_wave <- function(file, year) {
  d <- read_excel(file, sheet = 1)

  death_col <- paste0("death_", year)
  dibao_col <- paste0("dibao_", year)
  hukou_col <- paste0("hukou_", year)

  required_cols <- c(
    "individual_id", "household_id", "community_id", "sex", "age",
    "marriage_status_raw", death_col, dibao_col, hukou_col,
    "num_children", "coresident_child", "household_income_per_capita"
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(d))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing required columns in ", file, ": ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  if (!"birth_year_used" %in% names(d)) d$birth_year_used <- NA_real_
  if (!"death_year" %in% names(d)) d$death_year <- NA_real_
  if (!"death_month" %in% names(d)) d$death_month <- NA_real_
  if (!"record_source" %in% names(d)) d$record_source <- NA_character_

  d$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(d$individual_id))
  d$household_id  <- trimws(as.character(d$household_id))
  d$community_id  <- trimws(as.character(d$community_id))

  if (year == 2011) {
    d$individual_id <- standardize_2011_individual_id(d$individual_id)
    d$household_id  <- standardize_2011_household_id(d$household_id)
  }

  if (any(is.na(d$individual_id) | d$individual_id == "")) {
    stop(paste0("Missing individual_id detected in ", file))
  }

  if (any(duplicated(d$individual_id))) {
    stop(paste0("Duplicate individual_id detected within wave ", year, "."))
  }

  bad_iid <- !is.na(d$individual_id) & nchar(d$individual_id) != 12
  bad_hid <- !is.na(d$household_id) & nchar(d$household_id) != 10

  if (any(bad_iid)) {
    stop(paste0("Unexpected individual_id length after standardization in wave ", year, "."))
  }

  if (any(bad_hid)) {
    stop(paste0("Unexpected household_id length after standardization in wave ", year, "."))
  }

  out <- data.frame(
    individual_id = d$individual_id,
    household_id = d$household_id,
    community_id = d$community_id,
    wave = as.integer(year),
    sex = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$sex)),
    age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$age)),
    birth_year_used = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$birth_year_used)),
    marriage_status_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$marriage_status_raw)),
    death = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[death_col]])),
    dibao = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[dibao_col]])),
    hukou = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[hukou_col]])),
    num_children = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$num_children)),
    coresident_child_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$coresident_child)),
    household_income_per_capita = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$household_income_per_capita)),
    death_year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$death_year)),
    death_month = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$death_month)),
    record_source = as.character(d$record_source),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out
}

cat("\nReading five cleaned waves...\n")
d2011 <- read_clean_wave(file_2011, 2011)
d2013 <- read_clean_wave(file_2013, 2013)
d2015 <- read_clean_wave(file_2015, 2015)
d2018 <- read_clean_wave(file_2018, 2018)
d2020 <- read_clean_wave(file_2020, 2020)

all_long <- bind_rows(d2011, d2013, d2015, d2018, d2020) %>%
  arrange(individual_id, wave)

cat("Unique persons in five cleaned files:", n_distinct(all_long$individual_id), "\n")
cat("Unique households in five cleaned files:", n_distinct(all_long$household_id), "\n")

# ------------------------------
# 4. Fixed sex from earliest valid observation
# ------------------------------
sex_history <- all_long %>%
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sex_fixed = first_valid_sex(sex),
    n_valid_sex_values = n_distinct(sex[sex %in% c(1, 2)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

n_sex_conflict <- sum(sex_history$n_valid_sex_values > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
if (n_sex_conflict > 0) {
  warning(paste0(n_sex_conflict, " persons have conflicting valid sex values across waves; earliest valid sex is used."))
}

# ------------------------------
# 4A. Fixed Hukou from the first valid record of each person
# 1 = Rural (agricultural); 2 = Urban (non-agricultural).
# Ignore all other values. An initially missing Hukou can be filled by the
# first valid later survey, and that value applies to ALL risk intervals.
# ------------------------------
hukou_history <- all_long %>%
  arrange(individual_id, wave) %>%
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
  summarise(
    hukou_fixed = {
      valid <- hukou[hukou %in% c(1, 2)]
      if (length(valid) == 0) NA_integer_ else as.integer(valid[1])
    },
    first_hukou_wave = {
      idx <- which(hukou %in% c(1, 2))
      if (length(idx) == 0) NA_integer_ else as.integer(wave[idx[1]])
    },
    hukou_n_valid_categories = n_distinct(hukou[hukou %in% c(1, 2)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nHukou history: ", nrow(hukou_history), " persons; ",
    sum(is.na(hukou_history$hukou_fixed)), " without valid Hukou; ",
    sum(hukou_history$hukou_n_valid_categories > 1),
    " with different valid Hukou values across waves.\n", sep = "")

# ------------------------------
# 5. Household Dibao history
# Ever: any explicit Dibao == 1.
# Unknown: no Yes, but at least one ALIVE respondent record has missing Dibao.
# Never: no Yes, no alive missing, and at least one explicit No.
# Death-only rows with missing Dibao do NOT turn a Never household into Unknown.
# ------------------------------
household_dibao <- all_long %>%
  group_by(household_id) %>%
  summarise(
    any_yes = any(dibao == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_alive_missing = any(death == 0 & is.na(dibao), na.rm = TRUE),
    any_no = any(dibao == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_yes_wave = if (any(dibao == 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(wave[dibao == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dibao_group = case_when(
      any_yes ~ "Ever",
      !any_yes & any_alive_missing ~ "Unknown",
      !any_yes & !any_alive_missing & any_no ~ "Never",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

cat("\nHousehold Dibao classification:\n")
print(table(household_dibao$dibao_group, useNA = "ifany"))

# 6. Method A long-term household per-capita income
# One household-wave value first, then mean across available waves.
# Missing waves are NOT treated as zero.
# ------------------------------
income_hh_wave <- all_long %>%
  group_by(household_id, wave) %>%
  summarise(
    n_distinct_income = n_distinct(household_income_per_capita[!is.na(household_income_per_capita)]),
    income_wave = first_nonmissing(household_income_per_capita),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(income_hh_wave$n_distinct_income > 1)) {
  bad <- income_hh_wave %>% filter(n_distinct_income > 1)
  print(head(bad, 20))
  stop("At least one household-wave has conflicting non-missing household_income_per_capita values.")
}

household_income_A <- income_hh_wave %>%
  group_by(household_id) %>%
  summarise(
    household_income_A = if (all(is.na(income_wave))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(income_wave, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    n_income_waves = sum(!is.na(income_wave)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------
# 7. Reconstruct death time exactly as in revised Method A
# Priority:
#   (1) 2013 reported death year/month where available
#   (2) cleaned birth_year_used + cleaned death age
# Invalid raw time -> midpoint between last alive wave and first death-report wave
# If no prior alive wave -> first death-report wave
# ------------------------------
make_death_info <- function(d) {
  d <- d[order(d$wave), ]
  individual_id <- d$individual_id[1]

  alive_waves <- d$wave[!is.na(d$death) & d$death == 0]
  dead_rows <- d[!is.na(d$death) & d$death == 1, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(dead_rows) == 0) {
    last_alive_wave <- if (length(alive_waves) > 0) max(alive_waves) else NA_real_

    return(data.frame(
      individual_id = individual_id,
      death_confirmed = 0L,
      death_report_wave = NA_real_,
      death_time_raw = NA_real_,
      death_time = NA_real_,
      death_source_raw = NA_character_,
      death_time_source = NA_character_,
      death_time_issue = NA_character_,
      last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  dead_rows <- dead_rows[order(dead_rows$wave), , drop = FALSE]
  dr <- dead_rows[1, , drop = FALSE]
  report_wave <- as.numeric(dr$wave[1])

  prior_alive <- alive_waves[alive_waves < report_wave]
  last_alive_wave <- if (length(prior_alive) > 0) max(prior_alive) else NA_real_

  death_time_raw <- NA_real_
  death_source_raw <- "missing"

  if (report_wave == 2013 && !is.na(dr$death_year[1])) {
    if (!is.na(dr$death_month[1]) && dr$death_month[1] >= 1 && dr$death_month[1] <= 12) {
      death_time_raw <- dr$death_year[1] + (dr$death_month[1] - 0.5) / 12
      death_source_raw <- "reported_year_month"
    } else {
      death_time_raw <- dr$death_year[1]
      death_source_raw <- "reported_year"
    }
  } else if (!is.na(dr$birth_year_used[1]) && !is.na(dr$age[1])) {
    death_time_raw <- dr$birth_year_used[1] + dr$age[1]
    death_source_raw <- "cleaned_death_age"
  }

  death_time_issue <- NA_character_
  raw_valid <- TRUE

  if (is.na(death_time_raw)) {
    raw_valid <- FALSE
    death_time_issue <- "death_time_missing"
  } else if (!is.na(last_alive_wave) && death_time_raw <= last_alive_wave) {
    raw_valid <- FALSE
    death_time_issue <- "death_time_not_after_last_alive"
  } else if (death_time_raw > report_wave) {
    raw_valid <- FALSE
    death_time_issue <- "death_time_after_report_wave"
  }

  if (raw_valid) {
    death_time <- death_time_raw
    death_time_source <- death_source_raw
  } else if (!is.na(last_alive_wave)) {
    death_time <- (last_alive_wave + report_wave) / 2
    death_time_source <- "fallback_midpoint"
  } else {
    death_time <- report_wave
    death_time_source <- "fallback_first_dead_wave"
  }

  data.frame(
    individual_id = individual_id,
    death_confirmed = 1L,
    death_report_wave = report_wave,
    death_time_raw = death_time_raw,
    death_time = death_time,
    death_source_raw = death_source_raw,
    death_time_source = death_time_source,
    death_time_issue = death_time_issue,
    last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

cat("\nReconstructing death times...\n")
death_info <- bind_rows(
  lapply(split(all_long, all_long$individual_id), make_death_info)
)

# ------------------------------
# 8. Create candidate start-wave records
# Start waves: 2011, 2013, 2015, 2018
# Only alive respondent records at interval start.
# ------------------------------
start_waves <- c(2011L, 2013L, 2015L, 2018L)

candidate0 <- all_long %>%
  filter(wave %in% start_waves, death == 0) %>%
  left_join(sex_history %>% select(individual_id, sex_fixed), by = "individual_id") %>%
  left_join(hukou_history %>% select(individual_id, hukou_fixed), by = "individual_id") %>%
  left_join(
    household_dibao %>% select(household_id, dibao_group, first_yes_wave),
    by = "household_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(household_income_A, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(death_info, by = "individual_id")

candidate1 <- candidate0 %>%
  filter(dibao_group %in% c("Ever", "Never"))

candidate2 <- candidate1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), age >= 45)

candidate3 <- candidate2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex_fixed), sex_fixed %in% c(1, 2))

candidate4 <- candidate3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(household_income_A))

candidate5 <- candidate4 %>%
  filter(
    dibao_group == "Never" |
      (dibao_group == "Ever" & !is.na(first_yes_wave) & wave >= first_yes_wave)
  )

cat("\nMethod A sample construction before interval stopping:\n")
cat("Alive start-wave records:", nrow(candidate0), "\n")
cat("Eligible Ever/Never records:", nrow(candidate1), "\n")
cat("Age >=45 records:", nrow(candidate2), "\n")
cat("Fixed sex available:", nrow(candidate3), "\n")
cat("Long-term income available:", nrow(candidate4), "\n")
cat("At/after Ever entry when applicable:", nrow(candidate5), "\n")

# ------------------------------
# 9. Build start-stop intervals
# Non-dead persons are censored at last observed alive wave.
# Dead persons end at reconstructed death_time.
# A future alive observation can confirm survival through an intermediate end wave.
# ------------------------------
analysis_intervals <- candidate5 %>%
  mutate(
    start = as.numeric(wave),
    next_wave = case_when(
      wave == 2011 ~ 2013,
      wave == 2013 ~ 2015,
      wave == 2015 ~ 2018,
      wave == 2018 ~ 2020,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    observation_end = ifelse(death_confirmed == 1, death_time, last_alive_wave),
    stop = pmin(next_wave, observation_end),
    event = ifelse(
      death_confirmed == 1 & !is.na(death_time) &
        death_time > start & death_time <= stop,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stop), stop > start)

cat("\nFinal positive-length common Method A intervals:", nrow(analysis_intervals), "\n")
cat("Unique persons:", n_distinct(analysis_intervals$individual_id), "\n")
cat("Death events:", sum(analysis_intervals$event), "\n")

# ------------------------------
# 10. Common Method A income tertile cutoffs
# Cutoffs are calculated from unique eligible households in final Ever+Never intervals.
# ------------------------------
eligible_households <- analysis_intervals %>%
  distinct(household_id, household_income_A)

income_cutoffs <- quantile(
  eligible_households$household_income_A,
  probs = c(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
  na.rm = TRUE,
  type = 7,
  names = FALSE
)

q1 <- as.numeric(income_cutoffs[1])
q2 <- as.numeric(income_cutoffs[2])

cat("\nMethod A common income cutoffs:\n")
cat("T1/T2 cutoff =", q1, "\n")
cat("T2/T3 cutoff =", q2, "\n")

analysis_intervals <- analysis_intervals %>%
  mutate(
    income_tertile = cut(
      household_income_A,
      breaks = c(-Inf, q1, q2, Inf),
      labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = TRUE
    ),
    sex = factor(
      ifelse(sex_fixed == 1, "Male", "Female"),
      levels = c("Male", "Female")
    ),
    hukou = factor(
      case_when(
        hukou_fixed == 1 ~ "Rural",
        hukou_fixed == 2 ~ "Urban",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Rural", "Urban")
    ),
    marriage_status = marriage_group(marriage_status_raw),
    living_children = children_group(num_children),
    coresident_child = coresident_group(coresident_child_raw),
    age_group = age_group_function(age)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    income_tertile = factor(income_tertile, levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")),
    marriage_status = factor(
      marriage_status,
      levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married", "Unknown")
    ),
    living_children = factor(
      living_children,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
    ),
    coresident_child = factor(
      coresident_child,
      levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
    ),
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
    )
  )

if (any(is.na(analysis_intervals$age_group))) {
  stop("Missing age_group detected after age >=45 filtering.")
}

# 11. Read ADL/IADL wide file and convert to person-wave long data
# ADL range: 0-6
# IADL range: 0-5
# Higher score = greater functional difficulty.
# ------------------------------
cat("\nReading ADL/IADL wide file...\n")
adl_wide <- read_excel(file_adl, sheet = 1)
adl_wide$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(adl_wide$individual_id))

adl_cols  <- paste0("adl_", c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020))
iadl_cols <- paste0("iadl_", c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020))
required_adl_cols <- c("individual_id", adl_cols, iadl_cols)

missing_adl_cols <- setdiff(required_adl_cols, names(adl_wide))
if (length(missing_adl_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required ADL/IADL columns: ",
      paste(missing_adl_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

if (any(is.na(adl_wide$individual_id) | adl_wide$individual_id == "")) {
  stop("Missing individual_id detected in ADL/IADL wide file.")
}

if (any(duplicated(adl_wide$individual_id))) {
  stop("Duplicate individual_id detected in ADL/IADL wide file.")
}

for (v in c(adl_cols, iadl_cols)) {
  adl_wide[[v]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(adl_wide[[v]]))
}

bad_adl <- unlist(adl_wide[adl_cols], use.names = FALSE)
bad_adl <- bad_adl[!is.na(bad_adl)]
if (length(bad_adl) > 0 && any(bad_adl < 0 | bad_adl > 6)) {
  stop("ADL values outside the expected 0-6 range were detected.")
}

bad_iadl <- unlist(adl_wide[iadl_cols], use.names = FALSE)
bad_iadl <- bad_iadl[!is.na(bad_iadl)]
if (length(bad_iadl) > 0 && any(bad_iadl < 0 | bad_iadl > 5)) {
  stop("IADL values outside the expected 0-5 range were detected.")
}

cleaned_ids <- unique(all_long$individual_id)
unmatched_ids <- setdiff(cleaned_ids, adl_wide$individual_id)
if (length(unmatched_ids) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "ADL/IADL wide file is missing ", length(unmatched_ids),
      " individual IDs that are present in the cleaned waves."
    )
  )
}

adl_long <- adl_wide %>%
  select(all_of(required_adl_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -individual_id,
    names_to = c(".value", "wave"),
    names_pattern = "^(adl|iadl)_(\\d{4})$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(wave = as.integer(wave)) %>%
  arrange(individual_id, wave)

if (any(duplicated(adl_long[c("individual_id", "wave")]))) {
  stop("Duplicate individual_id-wave rows detected after reshaping ADL/IADL data.")
}

analysis_intervals <- analysis_intervals %>%
  left_join(adl_long, by = c("individual_id", "wave"))

# ------------------------------
# 12. Never-Dibao formal sample
# Marriage Unknown is excluded from formal Cox models.
# Children and coresidence Unknown remain as explicit categories.
# ------------------------------
never_before_hukou <- analysis_intervals %>%
  filter(dibao_group == "Never") %>%
  filter(marriage_status != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    marriage_status = factor(
      as.character(marriage_status),
      levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married")
    )
  )

# Persons without any valid 2011-2020 Hukou are excluded from Cox analysis.
never_original <- never_before_hukou %>%
  filter(!is.na(hukou))

cat("\nExcluded for missing Hukou in original Never sample: ",
    n_distinct(never_before_hukou$individual_id) - n_distinct(never_original$individual_id),
    " persons; ", nrow(never_before_hukou) - nrow(never_original),
    " intervals; ", sum(never_before_hukou$event) - sum(never_original$event),
    " deaths.\n", sep = "")

# Common M1-M4 sample: both ADL and IADL must be observed at interval start.
never_common <- never_original %>%
  filter(!is.na(adl), !is.na(iadl))

cat("\nNever-Dibao sample sizes:\n")
cat(
  "Original M1: ", n_distinct(never_original$individual_id), " persons; ",
  nrow(never_original), " intervals; ", sum(never_original$event), " deaths; ",
  sum(never_original$stop - never_original$start), " person-years.\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "Common ADL/IADL sample: ", n_distinct(never_common$individual_id), " persons; ",
  nrow(never_common), " intervals; ", sum(never_common$event), " deaths; ",
  sum(never_common$stop - never_common$start), " person-years.\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "Excluded from the common sample because ADL and/or IADL is missing at interval start: ",
  nrow(never_original) - nrow(never_common), " intervals; ",
  n_distinct(never_original$individual_id) - n_distinct(never_common$individual_id), " persons; ",
  sum(never_original$event) - sum(never_common$event), " deaths.\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (nrow(never_common) == 0 || sum(never_common$event) == 0) {
  stop("The common ADL/IADL Never-Dibao sample has no usable intervals or no death events.")
}

# ------------------------------
# 13. Cox models
# Original_M1 = original Method A Never model on full formal Never sample.
# Common_M1   = same model on the common ADL/IADL sample.
# M2_ADL      = Common_M1 + ADL.
# M3_IADL     = Common_M1 + IADL.
# M4_ADL_IADL = Common_M1 + ADL + IADL.
# All common-sample models therefore use exactly the same person-period records.
# ------------------------------
fit_cox <- function(data, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = FALSE) {
  rhs <- c(
    "sex",
    "hukou",
    "income_tertile",
    "marriage_status",
    "living_children",
    "coresident_child"
  )

  if (add_adl) rhs <- c(rhs, "adl")
  if (add_iadl) rhs <- c(rhs, "iadl")
  rhs <- c(rhs, "strata(age_group)")

  form <- as.formula(
    paste("Surv(start, stop, event) ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "))
  )

  coxph(
    formula = form,
    data = data,
    ties = "efron",
    cluster = individual_id,
    robust = TRUE,
    x = TRUE,
    model = TRUE
  )
}

cat("\nFitting Cox models...\n")
fit_original_m1 <- fit_cox(never_original, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = FALSE)
fit_common_m1   <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = FALSE)
fit_m2_adl      <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = TRUE,  add_iadl = FALSE)
fit_m3_iadl     <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = FALSE, add_iadl = TRUE)
fit_m4_both     <- fit_cox(never_common, add_adl = TRUE,  add_iadl = TRUE)

fits <- list(
  Original_M1 = fit_original_m1,
  Common_M1 = fit_common_m1,
  M2_ADL = fit_m2_adl,
  M3_IADL = fit_m3_iadl,
  M4_ADL_IADL = fit_m4_both
)

model_data <- list(
  Original_M1 = never_original,
  Common_M1 = never_common,
  M2_ADL = never_common,
  M3_IADL = never_common,
  M4_ADL_IADL = never_common
)

# ------------------------------
# 14. Extract complete Cox results: beta, robust SE, HR, 95% CI, p
# ------------------------------
comparison_label <- function(term) {
  labels <- c(
    "sexFemale" = "Female vs Male",
    "hukouUrban" = "Non-agricultural vs Agricultural Hukou",
    "income_tertileT2" = "Income T2 vs T1",
    "income_tertileT3" = "Income T3 vs T1",
    "marriage_statusWidowed" = "Widowed vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced" = "Separated-Divorced vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusNever married" = "Never married vs Partnered",
    "living_children1" = "Living children: 1 vs 0",
    "living_children2" = "Living children: 2 vs 0",
    "living_children3+" = "Living children: 3+ vs 0",
    "living_childrenUnknown" = "Living children: Unknown vs 0",
    "coresident_childYes" = "Coresident child: Yes vs No",
    "coresident_childUnknown" = "Coresident child: Unknown vs No",
    "adl" = "ADL: per 1-point increase",
    "iadl" = "IADL: per 1-point increase"
  )

  ifelse(term %in% names(labels), unname(labels[term]), term)
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit, model_name) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  cm <- s$coefficients

  if (is.null(dim(cm))) {
    cm <- matrix(cm, nrow = 1)
  }

  beta <- as.numeric(cm[, "coef"])

  if ("robust se" %in% colnames(cm)) {
    robust_se <- as.numeric(cm[, "robust se"])
  } else {
    robust_se <- as.numeric(cm[, "se(coef)"])
  }

  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(cm), value = TRUE)
  if (length(p_col) == 0) stop(paste0("Could not find p-value column for model ", model_name))
  p_value <- as.numeric(cm[, p_col[1]])

  term <- rownames(cm)
  z975 <- qnorm(0.975)

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    term = term,
    Comparison = comparison_label(term),
    beta = beta,
    robust_SE = robust_se,
    HR = exp(beta),
    lower_95 = exp(beta - z975 * robust_se),
    upper_95 = exp(beta + z975 * robust_se),
    p_value = p_value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

full_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(fits), function(nm) extract_cox_results(fits[[nm]], nm))
)

# ------------------------------
# 15. Compact model comparison table
# ------------------------------
get_effect <- function(result_table, model_name, term_name) {
  x <- result_table %>%
    filter(Model == model_name, term == term_name)

  if (nrow(x) == 0) {
    return(c(HR = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  c(
    HR = x$HR[1],
    lower = x$lower_95[1],
    upper = x$upper_95[1],
    p = x$p_value[1]
  )
}

format_ci <- function(hr, lower, upper) {
  if (any(is.na(c(hr, lower, upper)))) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", hr, lower, upper)
}

build_model_comparison_row <- function(model_name) {
  d <- model_data[[model_name]]

  hukou <- get_effect(full_results, model_name, "hukouUrban")
  core <- get_effect(full_results, model_name, "coresident_childYes")
  adl  <- get_effect(full_results, model_name, "adl")
  iadl <- get_effect(full_results, model_name, "iadl")

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Sample = ifelse(
      model_name == "Original_M1",
      "Original Method A Never sample",
      "Common ADL+IADL complete-case person-period sample"
    ),
    Persons = n_distinct(d$individual_id),
    Intervals = nrow(d),
    Deaths = sum(d$event),
    Person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start),
    Hukou_HR_95CI = format_ci(hukou["HR"], hukou["lower"], hukou["upper"]),
    Hukou_p = hukou["p"],
    Coresident_HR_95CI = format_ci(core["HR"], core["lower"], core["upper"]),
    Coresident_p = core["p"],
    ADL_HR_95CI = format_ci(adl["HR"], adl["lower"], adl["upper"]),
    ADL_p = adl["p"],
    IADL_HR_95CI = format_ci(iadl["HR"], iadl["lower"], iadl["upper"]),
    IADL_p = iadl["p"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

model_comparison <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(fits), build_model_comparison_row)
)

# 16. PH diagnostics
# No automatic alternative model is created.
# We only report potential PH problems.
# ------------------------------
extract_ph <- function(fit, model_name) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      z <- cox.zph(fit, terms = TRUE, global = TRUE)
      tb <- as.data.frame(z$table)
      tb$term <- rownames(tb)
      rownames(tb) <- NULL

      data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        term = tb$term,
        chisq = as.numeric(tb$chisq),
        df = as.numeric(tb$df),
        p_value = as.numeric(tb$p),
        PH_flag = ifelse(
          as.numeric(tb$p) < 0.05,
          "Potential PH violation (p<0.05)",
          "No evidence of PH violation at 0.05"
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning(paste0("cox.zph failed for ", model_name, ": ", conditionMessage(e)))

      data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
        chisq = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        PH_flag = conditionMessage(e),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
}

ph_diagnostics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(fits), function(nm) extract_ph(fits[[nm]], nm))
)

# ------------------------------
# 17. Reproduction QA and Hukou checks
# Check the pre-Hukou cohort against previous results. Previous coefficients
# cannot be expected to reproduce after adding a new model predictor.
# ------------------------------
qa_messages <- character(0)

if (n_distinct(never_before_hukou$individual_id) != 17385) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Pre-Hukou Never person count differs from expected 17385.")
}
if (n_distinct(never_before_hukou$household_id) != 9638) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Pre-Hukou Never household count differs from expected 9638.")
}
if (nrow(never_before_hukou) != 52058) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Pre-Hukou Never interval count differs from expected 52058.")
}
if (sum(never_before_hukou$event) != 1414) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Pre-Hukou Never death count differs from expected 1414.")
}
if (abs(sum(never_before_hukou$stop - never_before_hukou$start) - 116669.291666667) > 1e-6) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Pre-Hukou Never person-years differ from expected 116669.291666667.")
}
if (abs(q1 - 3924.44444444444) > 1e-6) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Method A lower tertile cutoff differs from the previous revised result.")
}
if (abs(q2 - 11548.3548148148) > 1e-6) {
  qa_messages <- c(qa_messages, "Method A upper tertile cutoff differs from the previous revised result.")
}
if (any(is.na(never_original$hukou))) {
  stop("Hukou missing values remain in the final Never model sample.")
}
if (any(!never_original$hukou %in% c("Rural", "Urban"))) {
  stop("Invalid Hukou category in the final Never model sample.")
}
if (!all(c("Rural", "Urban") %in% unique(as.character(never_original$hukou)))) {
  stop("Both Rural and Urban Hukou categories are required to estimate an HR.")
}
if (any(vapply(fits, function(fit) !("hukouUrban" %in% names(coef(fit))), logical(1)))) {
  stop("At least one Cox model does not contain the Hukou coefficient.")
}

cat("\nMethod A reproduction and Hukou check:\n")
if (length(qa_messages) == 0) {
  cat("PASS: pre-Hukou cohort and income cutoffs match the reference; Hukou is included in all five models.\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: one or more historical reference checks did not match:\n")
  for (m in qa_messages) cat(" - ", m, "\n", sep = "")
}

# ------------------------------
# 18. Console output: only the main results
# ------------------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("MAIN MODEL COMPARISON\n")
cat("HR > 1 means higher mortality hazard; HR < 1 means lower hazard.\n")
cat("ADL/IADL HRs are per 1-point increase in score.\n")
cat("Hukou HR compares Urban (2) vs Rural (1); first valid wave is fixed for all intervals.\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
print(model_comparison, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nGLOBAL PH TESTS\n")
print(
  ph_diagnostics %>%
    filter(term == "GLOBAL") %>%
    select(Model, chisq, df, p_value, PH_flag),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------
# 19. Write ONE Excel workbook with THREE sheets only
# ------------------------------
write_xlsx(
  list(
    Model_Comparison = model_comparison,
    Full_Cox_Results = full_results,
    PH_Diagnostics = ph_diagnostics
  ),
  path = output_file
)

cat("\nFinished.\n")
cat("Output file:", output_file, "\n")
cat("Sheets: Model_Comparison, Full_Cox_Results, PH_Diagnostics\n")
```







# Final
```{r}
# ================================================================
# Model B, Phase 1, Never Dibao -- adjusted for HUKOU + ADL/IADL
# This is ONE complete analysis script (no duplicated pipeline).
# It REUSES the common Method A RDS; it does NOT re-clean the 5 waves.
# Do not run Model A again if its current common RDS already exists.
#
# Fixed (from Method A): sex, first valid HUKOU (non-agricultural ref.),
# long-run mean household per-capita income tertile (common A cutoffs).
# Interval-start information (from Method A): marriage, living children,
# co-residence, age stratum. ADL/IADL are added from that same wave.
# Original cleaning and eligibility rules come directly from Method A RDS.
# All essential Model A cleaning/eligibility decisions are reused, not
# independently rebuilt from the five survey files.
#
# Five models:
#   Original_M1: A main formula, full eligible Never sample
#   Common_M1:   A main formula, joint ADL/IADL-complete intervals
#   M2_ADL:      Common_M1 + ADL
#   M3_IADL:     Common_M1 + IADL
#   M4_ADL_IADL: Common_M1 + ADL + IADL
# The last four models use EXACTLY the same start-stop intervals.
# No statistical models are executed until the user runs this script.
# ================================================================

# 0. Settings: keep the original working-directory convention.
DATA_DIR <- "."
A_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "A_Cox_outputs")
COMMON_RDS <- file.path(A_OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Cox_common_data.rds")
A_NEVER_RESULTS_RDS <- file.path(A_OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Never_models_and_results.rds")
ADL_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "CHARLS_2011_2020_wide_ADL_IADL.xlsx")
OUTPUT_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Model B1_Never_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx")

needed_packages <- c("survival", "readxl", "openxlsx")
not_installed <- needed_packages[
  !vapply(needed_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(not_installed)) {
  stop("Install the following R packages before running: ",
       paste(not_installed, collapse = ", "))
}
library(survival)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(COMMON_RDS)) {
  stop("Method A common RDS does not exist: ", COMMON_RDS,
       ". It is generated by the UPDATED Model A Ever script; ",
       "do not regenerate unless the A source data changed.")
}
if (!file.exists(ADL_FILE)) {
  stop("Missing ADL/IADL file: ", ADL_FILE,
       ". Its filename must NOT contain a '(number)' suffix.")
}

# 1. Read the EXACT common data, classifications and income cutoffs from A.
a_common <- readRDS(COMMON_RDS)
required_parts <- c("analysis_intervals", "income_cutoffs", "person_meta")
if (!all(required_parts %in% names(a_common))) {
  stop("Common RDS is incomplete or from an older A version. Missing: ",
       paste(setdiff(required_parts, names(a_common)), collapse = ", "))
}

base <- a_common$analysis_intervals
required_cols <- c(
  "individual_id", "household_id", "wave", "start", "stop", "event",
  "dibao_group", "sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
  "living_children", "coresident_child", "hukou", "age_group",
  "long_mean_household_income_pc"
)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(base))
if (length(missing_cols)) {
  stop("Common A intervals are missing required fields: ",
       paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       ". Regenerate the common RDS using the updated A-HUKOU script.")
}
if (!all(c("q1", "q2") %in% names(a_common$income_cutoffs))) {
  stop("Method A income_cutoffs must contain q1 and q2.")
}
q1 <- unname(a_common$income_cutoffs["q1"])
q2 <- unname(a_common$income_cutoffs["q2"])
if (any(!is.finite(c(q1, q2))) || q2 < q1) {
  stop("Invalid income tertile cutoffs in the common A RDS.")
}

base <- base[as.character(base$dibao_group) == "Never", , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(base)) stop("No Never Dibao intervals in the common A RDS.")
base$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(base$individual_id))
base$wave <- as.integer(as.character(base$wave))
if (anyNA(base$individual_id) || any(base$individual_id == "")) {
  stop("Missing individual IDs in Method A intervals.")
}
if (anyNA(base$wave) || any(!base$wave %in% c(2011L, 2013L, 2015L, 2018L))) {
  stop("Unexpected start wave in Method A intervals.")
}
if (anyNA(base$start) || anyNA(base$stop) ||
    any(!is.finite(base$start)) || any(!is.finite(base$stop)) ||
    any(base$stop <= base$start)) {
  stop("Invalid start-stop durations in Method A intervals.")
}
if (anyNA(base$event) || any(!base$event %in% c(0L, 1L))) {
  stop("Unexpected event coding in Method A intervals.")
}
if (!all(c("hukou_fixed", "hukou_first_wave") %in% names(base))) {
  stop("The common RDS does not contain the latest fixed-HUKOU fields.")
}
if (any(!is.na(base$hukou_fixed) & !base$hukou_fixed %in% c(1, 2))) {
  stop("Unexpected fixed HUKOU coding in Model A RDS (expected 1/2).")
}
expected_hukou <- ifelse(is.na(base$hukou_fixed), NA_character_,
                         ifelse(base$hukou_fixed == 1, "Agricultural",
                                ifelse(base$hukou_fixed == 2,
                                       "Non-agricultural", NA_character_)))
if (!identical(as.character(base$hukou), expected_hukou)) {
  stop("A HUKOU values do not agree with fixed raw coding 1/2.")
}
if (any(is.na(base$hukou_fixed) != is.na(base$hukou_first_wave))) {
  stop("First-valid HUKOU wave is inconsistent with missing HUKOU.")
}

# Check that the saved income categories match the ORIGINAL A thresholds.
income_expected <- ifelse(
  base$long_mean_household_income_pc <= q1, "T1",
  ifelse(base$long_mean_household_income_pc <= q2, "T2", "T3")
)
if (anyNA(income_expected) ||
    any(as.character(base$income_tertile) != income_expected)) {
  stop("Income tertiles in the common RDS are inconsistent with A cutoffs.")
}

# 2. Apply the SAME formal Never Cox inclusion rules as Model A.
# A excludes marriage Unknown first, then all-wave HUKOU-missing intervals.
unknown_marriage <- base[
  as.character(base$marriage_status) == "Unknown", , drop = FALSE
]
marriage_kept <- base[
  !is.na(base$marriage_status) &
    as.character(base$marriage_status) != "Unknown", , drop = FALSE
]
missing_hukou <- marriage_kept[
  is.na(marriage_kept$hukou), , drop = FALSE
]
never_original <- marriage_kept[
  !is.na(marriage_kept$hukou), , drop = FALSE
]
if (!nrow(never_original)) stop("No eligible Never intervals after A filters.")

# Reassert exactly the Method A reference groups in all five models.
prepare_factors <- function(d) {
  d$sex <- factor(as.character(d$sex), levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  d$income_tertile <- factor(as.character(d$income_tertile),
                             levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"))
  d$marriage_status <- factor(as.character(d$marriage_status),
                             levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed",
                                        "Separated-Divorced", "Never married"))
  d$living_children <- factor(as.character(d$living_children),
                              levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown"))
  d$coresident_child <- factor(as.character(d$coresident_child),
                               levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))
  d$hukou <- factor(as.character(d$hukou),
                    levels = c("Non-agricultural", "Agricultural"))
  d$age_group <- factor(as.character(d$age_group),
                        levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74",
                                   "75-84", "85-94", "95+"))
  d
}
never_original <- prepare_factors(never_original)
model_covariates <- c("sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
                      "living_children", "coresident_child", "hukou", "age_group")
if (anyNA(never_original[, model_covariates, drop = FALSE])) {
  stop("Unexpected missing model covariates after applying A sample rules.")
}
if (!all(c("Non-agricultural", "Agricultural") %in%
         as.character(unique(never_original$hukou)))) {
  stop("Both HUKOU categories must appear in the Never sample.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(never_original[, c("individual_id", "start")])) {
  stop("Duplicate individual_id/start intervals found in Method A RDS.")
}

# Strict check against the ALREADY SAVED phase-1 Never main model.
# It is read-only; Model A is not rerun and source data are unchanged.
if (!file.exists(A_NEVER_RESULTS_RDS)) {
  stop("Missing fitted Model A Never results RDS: ", A_NEVER_RESULTS_RDS,
       ". Run the latest Model A Never script on your own computer first.")
}
a_never <- readRDS(A_NEVER_RESULTS_RDS)
if (is.null(a_never$main_model)) {
  stop("A_Never_models_and_results.rds lacks main_model.")
}
same_n <- as.integer(a_never$main_model$n) == nrow(never_original)
same_events <- as.integer(a_never$main_model$nevent) == sum(never_original$event)
if (!isTRUE(same_n) || !isTRUE(same_events)) {
  stop("Model B Original_M1 sample does not match saved Model A Never. ",
       "Check that the common and Never results RDS come from the same A run.")
}
phase1_check <- "PASS: intervals and deaths agree with fitted Model A Never main model"

# 3. Read the original wide functional-status file (without re-cleaning A).
adl_wide <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(ADL_FILE, sheet = 1))
waves <- c(2011L, 2013L, 2015L, 2018L, 2020L)
adl_names <- paste0("adl_", waves)
iadl_names <- paste0("iadl_", waves)
required_adl <- c("individual_id", adl_names, iadl_names)
not_found <- setdiff(required_adl, names(adl_wide))
if (length(not_found)) {
  stop("ADL/IADL wide data are missing fields: ",
       paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))
}
adl_wide$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(adl_wide$individual_id))
if (anyNA(adl_wide$individual_id) || any(adl_wide$individual_id == "") ||
    anyDuplicated(adl_wide$individual_id)) {
  stop("Missing or duplicated individual_id in ADL/IADL wide dataset.")
}

# Preserve original scores, but reject unexpected nonnumeric codes.
score_to_numeric <- function(x, field, highest) {
  txt <- trimws(as.character(x))
  missing <- is.na(txt) | txt %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL")
  z <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(txt))
  if (any(!missing & (is.na(z) | !is.finite(z)))) {
    stop("Unrecognized non-numeric value in ", field,
         ". Inspect the original ADL/IADL source.")
  }
  if (any(!is.na(z) & (z < 0 | z > highest))) {
    stop("Value outside [0, ", highest, "] in ", field, ".")
  }
  z
}
for (nm in adl_names) adl_wide[[nm]] <- score_to_numeric(adl_wide[[nm]], nm, 6)
for (nm in iadl_names) adl_wide[[nm]] <- score_to_numeric(adl_wide[[nm]], nm, 5)

# Every A interval respondent must have a corresponding row in the wide file.
# Missing scores within that row remain NA (and are handled in the sample split).
missing_ids <- setdiff(unique(never_original$individual_id), adl_wide$individual_id)
if (length(missing_ids)) {
  stop(length(missing_ids), " Never respondent IDs are absent from ADL/IADL wide file. ",
       "Check the ID format and whether the correct wide file was supplied.")
}

# 4. Link the SAME-WAVE scores to the START of each A risk interval.
# No future ADL/IADL score is carried backward or used to fill missing values.
adl_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(waves, function(yr) {
  data.frame(
    individual_id = adl_wide$individual_id,
    wave = yr,
    adl = adl_wide[[paste0("adl_", yr)]],
    iadl = adl_wide[[paste0("iadl_", yr)]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
if (anyDuplicated(adl_long[, c("individual_id", "wave")])) {
  stop("Duplicated individual_id + wave after ADL/IADL reshaping.")
}

key_a <- paste(never_original$individual_id, never_original$wave, sep = "|")
key_adl <- paste(adl_long$individual_id, adl_long$wave, sep = "|")
idx <- match(key_a, key_adl)
if (anyNA(idx)) {
  stop("Missing individual_id/wave keys in ADL/IADL long data.")
}
never_original$adl <- adl_long$adl[idx]
never_original$iadl <- adl_long$iadl[idx]

# Joint complete-case interval sample, shared by Common_M1 through M4.
never_common <- never_original[
  !is.na(never_original$adl) & !is.na(never_original$iadl), , drop = FALSE
]
if (!nrow(never_common) || sum(never_common$event) < 1) {
  stop("No usable events/intervals after joint ADL/IADL complete-case selection.")
}

# Confirm that all model variables exist in both analysis samples.
if (anyNA(never_common[, c(model_covariates, "adl", "iadl"), drop = FALSE])) {
  stop("Unexpected missing covariates in common M1-M4 sample.")
}

# 5. Model definitions. Exactly the SAME A main formula for M1.
formula_main <- survival::Surv(start, stop, event) ~
  sex + income_tertile + marriage_status + living_children +
  coresident_child + hukou + strata(age_group)
formula_adl <- update(formula_main, . ~ . + adl)
formula_iadl <- update(formula_main, . ~ . + iadl)
formula_both <- update(formula_main, . ~ . + adl + iadl)

formulas <- list(
  Original_M1 = formula_main,
  Common_M1 = formula_main,
  M2_ADL = formula_adl,
  M3_IADL = formula_iadl,
  M4_ADL_IADL = formula_both
)
model_data <- list(
  Original_M1 = never_original,
  Common_M1 = never_common,
  M2_ADL = never_common,
  M3_IADL = never_common,
  M4_ADL_IADL = never_common
)

fit_with_warnings <- function(f, data) {
  seen <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    survival::coxph(f, data = data, ties = "efron",
                    cluster = individual_id, robust = TRUE,
                    x = TRUE, model = TRUE),
    warning = function(w) {
      seen <<- c(seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(seen))
}

# 6. Run the five Cox models when THIS SCRIPT is executed locally by the user.
fits <- list()
fit_warnings <- data.frame(Model = character(), Warning = character(),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (nm in names(formulas)) {
  z <- fit_with_warnings(formulas[[nm]], model_data[[nm]])
  fits[[nm]] <- z$fit
  if (length(z$warnings)) {
    fit_warnings <- rbind(fit_warnings,
                          data.frame(Model = nm, Warning = z$warnings))
  }
}
if (!nrow(fit_warnings)) {
  fit_warnings <- data.frame(Model = "All", Warning = "No coxph warning recorded")
}

# Direct numerical reproducibility check: Original_M1 must reproduce the
# coefficients of the already fitted Method A Never main model.
reference_beta <- coef(a_never$main_model)
current_beta <- coef(fits$Original_M1)
if (!identical(names(reference_beta), names(current_beta)) ||
    !identical(is.na(reference_beta), is.na(current_beta)) ||
    any(abs(reference_beta[!is.na(reference_beta)] -
            current_beta[!is.na(current_beta)]) > 1e-7)) {
  stop("Original_M1 does not reproduce saved Model A Never coefficients. ",
       "Do not interpret Model B results until the A files are reconciled.")
}
phase1_check <- paste0(phase1_check, "; coefficients also agree")

# 7. Extract HR/95% CI/p with clustered robust standard errors.
label_term <- function(term) {
  terms_map <- c(
    "sexFemale" = "Female vs Male",
    "income_tertileT2" = "Income T2 vs T1",
    "income_tertileT3" = "Income T3 vs T1",
    "marriage_statusWidowed" = "Widowed vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced" = "Separated/Divorced vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusNever married" = "Never married vs Partnered",
    "living_children1" = "1 living child vs 0",
    "living_children2" = "2 living children vs 0",
    "living_children3+" = "3+ living children vs 0",
    "living_childrenUnknown" = "Living children Unknown vs 0",
    "coresident_childYes" = "Co-residence Yes vs No",
    "coresident_childUnknown" = "Co-residence Unknown vs No",
    "hukouAgricultural" = "Agricultural vs Non-agricultural HUKOU",
    "adl" = "ADL (per 1-point increase)",
    "iadl" = "IADL (per 1-point increase)"
  )
  out <- unname(terms_map[term])
  ifelse(is.na(out), term, out)
}

extract_result <- function(fit, model_name) {
  ss <- summary(fit)
  betas <- coef(fit)
  se_mat <- as.data.frame(ss$coefficients)
  if ("robust se" %in% names(se_mat)) {
    se <- se_mat[, "robust se"]
  } else {
    se <- se_mat[, "se(coef)"]
  }
  se <- as.numeric(se)
  p <- as.numeric(se_mat[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  b <- as.numeric(betas)
  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    term = names(betas),
    comparison = label_term(names(betas)),
    beta = b,
    robust_se = se,
    HR = exp(b),
    lower_95 = exp(b - qnorm(0.975) * se),
    upper_95 = exp(b + qnorm(0.975) * se),
    p_value = p,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
all_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(nm) {
  extract_result(fits[[nm]], nm)
}))
rownames(all_results) <- NULL

# 8. Compare all five models and their analysis samples.
model_comparison <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(nm) {
  d <- model_data[[nm]]
  subset_res <- all_results[all_results$Model == nm, , drop = FALSE]
  get_hr <- function(term) {
    rr <- subset_res[subset_res$term == term, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(rr)) return(NA_character_)
    sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", rr$HR[1], rr$lower_95[1], rr$upper_95[1])
  }
  get_p <- function(term) {
    rr <- subset_res[subset_res$term == term, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(rr)) return(NA_real_)
    rr$p_value[1]
  }
  data.frame(
    Model = nm,
    Sample = if (nm == "Original_M1") "Full A-aligned Never sample" else
      "ADL and IADL observed at interval start",
    Persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    Intervals = nrow(d),
    Deaths = sum(d$event),
    Person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start),
    Hukou_HR_95CI = get_hr("hukouAgricultural"),
    Hukou_p = get_p("hukouAgricultural"),
    Coresidence_HR_95CI = get_hr("coresident_childYes"),
    Coresidence_p = get_p("coresident_childYes"),
    ADL_HR_95CI = get_hr("adl"),
    ADL_p = get_p("adl"),
    IADL_HR_95CI = get_hr("iadl"),
    IADL_p = get_p("iadl"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(model_comparison) <- NULL

# 9. PH tests. Same KM-time transformation as Method A.
ph_test_one <- function(fit, f, d, model_name) {
  source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
  primary_error <- ""
  z <- tryCatch(survival::cox.zph(fit, transform = "km", terms = TRUE,
                                 global = TRUE), error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(z, "error")) {
    primary_error <- conditionMessage(z)
    source <- "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback"
    secondary <- tryCatch(
      survival::coxph(f, data = d, ties = "efron", x = TRUE, model = TRUE),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(secondary, "error")) {
      z <- secondary
    } else {
      z <- tryCatch(survival::cox.zph(secondary, transform = "km",
                                    terms = TRUE, global = TRUE),
                    error = function(e) e)
    }
  }
  if (inherits(z, "error")) {
    return(data.frame(Model = model_name, term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
                      chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                      diagnostic_source = source,
                      message = paste(primary_error, conditionMessage(z), sep = " / ")))
  }
  tb <- as.data.frame(z$table)
  data.frame(Model = model_name, term = rownames(tb),
             chisq = as.numeric(tb$chisq), df = as.numeric(tb$df),
             p_value = as.numeric(tb$p), diagnostic_source = source,
             message = primary_error, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
ph_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(nm) {
  ph_test_one(fits[[nm]], formulas[[nm]], model_data[[nm]], nm)
}))
rownames(ph_results) <- NULL

# 10. Sample, HUKOU and ADL/IADL audit; not additional model filtering.
qa <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Phase1 A Never sample verification",
    "Income lower cutpoint (A, all eligible households)",
    "Income upper cutpoint (A, all eligible households)",
    "Never intervals before exclusion of marriage Unknown",
    "Intervals excluded: marriage Unknown",
    "Intervals excluded: missing fixed HUKOU after marriage filter",
    "Deaths excluded: missing fixed HUKOU after marriage filter",
    "Original_M1 persons", "Original_M1 intervals", "Original_M1 deaths",
    "Common M1-M4 persons", "Common M1-M4 intervals", "Common M1-M4 deaths",
    "Excluded intervals for missing ADL or IADL",
    "Excluded deaths for missing ADL or IADL",
    "Original_M1 persons with first valid HUKOU from later than 2011"
  ),
  Value = as.character(c(
    phase1_check, format(q1, digits = 14), format(q2, digits = 14),
    nrow(base), nrow(unknown_marriage), nrow(missing_hukou),
    sum(missing_hukou$event),
    length(unique(never_original$individual_id)), nrow(never_original),
    sum(never_original$event), length(unique(never_common$individual_id)),
    nrow(never_common), sum(never_common$event),
    nrow(never_original) - nrow(never_common),
    sum(never_original$event) - sum(never_common$event),
    sum(a_common$person_meta$individual_id %in% never_original$individual_id &
          !is.na(a_common$person_meta$hukou_first_wave) &
          a_common$person_meta$hukou_first_wave > 2011)
  )),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("MODEL B PHASE 1: NEVER DIBAO | SAME METHOD A COMMON DATA\n")
cat("Non-agricultural HUKOU is the reference group.\n")
cat("Age/marriage/children/co-residence and ADL/IADL use interval-start waves.\n")
cat("M1-M4 use one common ADL/IADL-complete interval sample.\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
print(model_comparison, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nProportional-hazards diagnostic results:\n")
print(ph_results[, c("Model", "term", "p_value")], row.names = FALSE)
if (any(fit_warnings$Model != "All")) {
  cat("\nCox warnings were recorded; inspect Model_Warnings worksheet.\n")
}

# 11. Write one workbook, preserving the original three analysis sheets,
# and adding transparent sample checks without changing source files.
wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
write_sheet <- function(name, tbl) {
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, name)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, name, tbl)
  openxlsx::freezePane(wb, name, firstRow = TRUE)
}
write_sheet("Model_Comparison", model_comparison)
write_sheet("Full_Cox_Results", all_results)
write_sheet("PH_Diagnostics", ph_results)
write_sheet("Sample_QA", qa)
write_sheet("Model_Warnings", fit_warnings)
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, OUTPUT_FILE, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nOutput saved to: ", OUTPUT_FILE, "\n", sep = "")
```
